description.en: Former ethnarchy of Archelaus: Judaea, Samaria and Idumaea, with the governor at Caesarea.
description.ar: إثنارخية أرخيلاوس السابقة: اليهودية والسامرة وأدوميا، والحاكم في قيسارية.
description.he: האתנרכיה לשעבר של ארכלאוס: יהודה, שומרון ואידומיאה, והמושל בקיסריה.

sources.quote: The region under Archelaus’s rule (i.e., Judaea, Samaria, and Edom) became the province of Judaea
And now Archelaus's part of Judea was reduced into a province, and Coponius, one of the equestrian order among the Romans, was sent as a procurator
Cyrenius came himself into Judea, which was now added to the province of Syria, to take an account of their substance

description.en: Agrippa I's former kingdom (minus areas assigned to Agrippa II from 53/54) reconstituted as a province.
description.ar: مملكة أغريبا الأول السابقة (من دون المناطق المخصصة لأغريبا الثاني منذ 53/54) أُعيد تشكيلها إقليمًا.
description.he: ממלכתו לשעבר של אגריפס הראשון (פחות האזורים שהוקצו לאגריפס השני מ-53/54) הוקמה מחדש כמחוז.

sources.quote: In 44 the entire kingdom passed under Roman rule and was reconstituted as the procuratorial province of Judaea.
Nero, the new emperor, in 54 added territory near the Sea of Galilee to Agrippa’s realm.
This was what befell the Jews in the time of Cuspius Fadus's government.
The first procurator whom Claudius sent to Palestine was Cuspius Fadus

sources.locator: Antiquities 20.7.1 (Whiston), areas given to Agrippa II
sources.quote: when he had already completed the twelfth year of his reign, he bestowed upon Agrippa the tetrarchy of Philip and Batanea, and added thereto Trachonites, with Abila
The point of time at which the change took place is not explicitly stated anywhere.

notes.en: Some Decapolis cities were assigned to Judaea after 106.
notes.ar: أُلحقت بعض مدن الديكابوليس بيهودا بعد 106.
notes.he: חלק מערי הדקאפוליס צורפו ליהודה אחרי 106.
